selection: Fixed cases, seeds and queries, no filtering for learned bases or success. Seeds shuffle facts and rename nodes, not independent distributions. narrow92 deliberately truncates focus as a failure/fallback stress policy.
accounting: All arms pay the same native formation and retain the same frozen executable core. Raw/memo/basis are predecessor executors with complete full-source caches shared within each immutable episode/batch; memo also caches structural plans. Ordered/indexed/adaptive/narrow share the new scoped backend and checker, with a fresh context/index per query and no partial result cache. New local admission includes an independent full-source predecessor replay, charged as checker units. All timings include startup, formation, indexes, selection, verification, repeated queries and output; no attached checkpoint. Only final-batch answers serialized and oracle checked; repetitions are not additional independent oracle cases. Core excludes training answer rows. Control bytes describe peak serialized per-query index/work/events, not heap use or learned model parameters. Metrics91/92 have different units; do not compare their totals directly. Logical fuel is not a wall-time bound: allocation, list walks, model preflight and inspection are not fully charged.
